sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: International Time-Definite Small Parcel Courier Operations

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - statute law based on English common law tradition; customary law (fa'a Samoa) limited to land and chiefly title matters; offshore corporate law follows Anglo-BVI-style drafting under the International Companies Act 1987
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER-Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) - applies to Samoa
PRC-Samoa Agreement on the Promotion and Protection of Investments (status to be reverified against the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade treaty list at filing date)

Statutory exemption of International Companies from Samoan income tax, stamp duty, and exchange control under the International Companies Act 1987 renders DTA reliance unnecessary for the tax-exempt IC

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended, including the 2012 amendments); Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Act 2017; Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended); Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2007 (as amended); Business Licences Act 1998; FATF/APG obligations and Financial Intelligence Unit directives in force

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national identity card of each director, shareholder, and beneficial owner holding 25% or more
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of issuance
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Samoa is a Contracting Party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing of any corporate shareholder or director entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or registered agent of the parent jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, or consular legalization for non-apostille states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential or service address (utility bill or bank statement) for each individual director, shareholder, and UBO
Original bank reference letter for each director and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostilled where applicable; certified true copy accepted in accordance with SIFSA-licensed registered agent practice

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney in favor of the SIFSA-licensed registered agent

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs, and bank signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit sanctions notices, and FATF/APG high-risk and grey-list jurisdictions; foreign PEP enhanced due diligence with documented source of wealth and source of funds under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 and FIU guidance; adverse media and negative-news checks standard; OFAC SDN screening applied where USD settlement rails are used.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SIFSA International Companies Registry (all name filings submitted through SIFSA-licensed Registered Agents; no direct public self-service portal; company search via SIFSA registry enquiry)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory name must be in the Roman alphabet and filed in English; transliteration of Chinese names is accepted in romanized pinyin form as a parallel name; full-Chinese articles of association are permissible as internal constitutional documents, but the operative registered name appears on the Certificate of Incorporation in roman script; the name must end with a limited-liability designator such as Limited, Corporation, Incorporated, Ltd, Corp, or Inc.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Samoa (as an operative name element implying government sponsorship or misleading national connection)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On rejection the licensed Registered Agent files a written reconsideration request with the Registrar citing distinguishing wording and the requested relief; if refused, an administrative appeal is lodged with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour within 14 calendar days, followed by judicial review before the Supreme Court of Samoa; submission of three alternative names at first filing is recommended; reservation may be extended upon payment of the applicable renewal fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is not permissible as a substitute for the statutory registered office; every Samoa International Company must maintain a registered office and a licensed registered agent physically located in Samoa under the International Companies Act 1987. Operational functions such as dispatch coordination, contracting, and accounting may be performed abroad; for a pure offshore contracting arrangement, the registered agent's physical address satisfies the statutory mandate.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Registrar-level inspection of the registered office is rare (estimated below 5% annual probability); if the courier entity establishes a physical depot or employs staff in Samoa, inspection probability under the Business Licences Act 1998 and customs or labour regimes rises to moderate (approximately 25%); maintaining current registered-agent occupancy, accurate UBO records, and clean business-license premises materially mitigates the risk.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search, clearance, and reservation fee (up to three alternative names)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the SIFSA fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation filing fee - standard authorized share capital up to USD 1,000,000
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory incorporation tariff; graduated brackets apply above USD 1,000,000 authorized capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Act 2017 UBO register preparation and initial filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory regulatory fee plus agent compliance service at prevailing market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent services - first year (name approval, incorporation filing, registered office, annual government fee handling, and AML/KYC client file)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a Samoa International Company with full AML file

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Business licence application under the Business Licences Act 1998 (courier services activity code)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory licence fee under the Business Licences Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT onboarding - PEP, sanctions, and adverse media screening of all directors, shareholders, and UBOs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per screened individual, including database access fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, translation, and apostille of Chinese-issued shareholder and director documents (passports, power of attorney, corporate certificates)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and Ministry of Foreign Affairs in country of issuance, plus certified translation providers
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing government notary and apostille tariffs plus translation bench price

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Interim legal advisory for Stage 1 due diligence report and drafting of constitutional documents (including Chinese-facing articles)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark fixed fee for Stage 1

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended, Sections 6-10 on incorporation; Section 12 on Memorandum and Articles; Section 29 on registered office; Section 33 on directors
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Samoa International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation of an International Company, together with the International Company Constitution
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to an International Company; shares may be issued with or without par value, and no escrow or bank-capital deposit account is required before incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscriber's subscription to 1,000 ordinary shares of no par value is approved and accepted, and the allotment of such shares is ratified. FURTHER RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company in Apia, Samoa, as specified in the Constitution, is adopted, and the Registrar of International Companies is authorized to file the registered office designation and any subsequent change. FURTHER RESOLVED that [Name] and [Name] are appointed as the first directors, and the directors are elected to the offices of President, Secretary, and Treasurer as permitted by the Constitution, with full authority to open bank accounts and execute all commercial and regulatory documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Companies Registry, MCIL online client portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request through the MCIL online portal or in person at the Companies Registry office. Provide the proposed company name and indicate the intended use for an International Company limited by shares. The registry will conduct a conflict check against existing companies, protected names, and trademarks in Samoa.
required_dossiers: Copy of applicant's passport or director identity document
Letter of engagement from the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or undesirable character, file a fresh name reservation with a different distinctive element or request a written statement of refusal and submit a reconsideration submission within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Lodgment of the International Company Constitution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Cause the licensed registered agent to draft and sign the International Company Constitution in accordance with the International Companies Act 1987. The Constitution must state the name, registered office in Samoa, objects including international time-definite small parcel courier and logistics activities, share capital, and director provisions. Lodge the executed Constitution with the Registry for examination and acceptance.
required_dossiers: Consent to act forms from each director and officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries any provision, submit an amending memorandum or revised instrument within 15 days; if non-conformity persists, withdraw the filing and resubmit after the prescribed correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Appointment of Initial Officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon acceptance of the Constitution and receipt of the government filing fee, the Registrar will issue the Certificate of Incorporation. Immediately thereafter, hold the first board meeting in person or by written resolution to adopt the registered office, subscribe to shares, and appoint directors and officers. Endorse the Certificate with the company number and registration date.
required_dossiers: Minutes or written resolution of the first board meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains a clerical error or incorrect date, submit a formal request for administrative rectification to the Registrar with a statutory declaration; corrected certificates normally issue within 5 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Agent and Registered Office Appointment Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm that a licensed registered agent in Samoa has executed the registered agent agreement and that the physical registered office address in Apia is documented. File the notice of change of registered office and registered agent with the Registry so that the public record reflects the statutory obligations under the International Companies Act 1987.
required_dossiers: Consent of registered agent to act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent is disqualified or the office is non-compliant, appoint a substitute licensed agent within 30 days and file a fresh consent and address notice; late filing penalties may apply but are cured upon payment and resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Optional Tax and Economic Substance Registration or Declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa Ministry of Revenue; Samoa International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Ascertain whether the International Company qualifies for the tax-exempt regime. For express courier operations with actual local physical presence or Samoa-source activities, register with the Ministry of Revenue to obtain a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) and any applicable income tax, VAT, or payroll obligations. Submit annual economic substance declaration and accounting records retention confirmation to the Registry.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation
Constitution and board resolution confirming business scope
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Ministry of Revenue challenges the tax exemption or imposes retrospective registration, provide a written position paper supported by legal advice within 21 days and, if necessary, apply for a binding private ruling before any penalty is finalized.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Samoa Regulator, Office of the Regulator for Postal and Electronic Communications (POST/Telecommunications Division), Ministry of Communications and Information Technology
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: International Express Courier Operator Licence under the Postal Services Act 2010 and the Samoa Postal Sector Regulations 2010

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Environmental Assessment Division, Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 — Environmental Registration for facilities with limited footprint, requiring a preliminary environmental review report rather than a full EIA
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Samoa National Environmental Standards: no unauthorized discharge of aqueous effluents to groundwater or surface water; waste handling records must demonstrate segregation and lawful disposal through an MNRE-registered waste carrier; vehicle fleet emissions must meet the Clean Air Act and reasonable particulate/NOx standards; noise levels at the operational boundary limited to 55 dB(A) between 10 p.m. and 7 a.m. and 70 dB(A) during daytime; any refrigerated or dry-cell battery waste must be handled as hazardous waste under MNRE guidelines.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA) covering the registered office and any local courier hub or warehouse; structural load inspection and building code clearance for storage shelving and vehicle docking areas issued by the Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA); workplace health and safety clearance from the Ministry of Labour and Workplace Relations confirming emergency exits, first-aid facilities, safe material handling procedures, and workers compensation insurance coverage.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (MfR), Government of Samoa — online portal: Tax Administration System (TAS), https://www.mfr.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: (1) Incorporate the International Company (IC) via a licensed Samoan registered agent under the International Companies Act 2007; (2) the registered agent submits to the Ministry for Revenue an Application for Taxpayer Identification Number accompanied by the Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association, Certificate of Registered Office, Registered Agent Consent, and certified passport copies of directors and shareholders; (3) MfR validates the IC's tax-exempt status and issues a TIN within approximately five business days; (4) the TIN is activated on the TAS portal and is thereafter used for VAT filings, customs transactions, and any withholding obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — the Samoa International Company is a non-resident, tax-privileged entity under the Income Tax Act 2015 and International Companies Act 2007; an IC that does not carry on business within Samoa and derives income from sources outside Samoa is exempt from corporate income tax, VAT, and stamp duty; a small annual government fee is payable to the Registrar of International and Foreign Companies.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists in Samoa. Available elections: (a) an IC may elect to be continued and re-registered as a domestic Samoan company, thereby opting into the ordinary income tax and VAT regime; (b) an IC may apply to the Ministry for Revenue for a binding private tax ruling confirming the scope of its exemption; (c) the IC may elect its reporting currency and financial statement basis under the International Companies Act; and (d) hybrid mismatch rules in the Income Tax Act 2015 may require re-characterization where a foreign jurisdiction treats the IC as fiscally transparent.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act 2018, effective 1 October 2019
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Compulsory registration where WST$500,000 of annual taxable turnover is met or exceeded in any 12-month period; voluntary registration is available below the threshold; VAT applies at customs on imported goods regardless of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API e-invoicing, or digital stamping mandate is currently in force in Samoa. VAT-registered persons must issue tax invoices in the prescribed form under the VAT Act 2018; VAT returns and schedules are filed electronically through the TAS portal; customs declarations are processed in the ASYCUDA World system; digitally issued invoices are acceptable provided they contain the prescribed particulars and remain verifiable on audit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available to a VAT-registered person where: (a) goods are physically exported from Samoa within 28 days of supply, or such longer period as approved by the Ministry for Revenue, and the exporter retains customs-validated proof of export; (b) services are supplied to a non-resident recipient who is outside Samoa at the time the services are performed and the benefit of the services is not enjoyed in Samoa; cross-border express courier and international freight transport of small parcels from Samoa to foreign destinations qualifies as an exported service where the contractual recipient is a non-resident and the transit terminates outside Samoa; supporting evidence must include the contract, airway bill or customs declaration, and proof of receipt of funds from a foreign-source account.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (CED) validated in the ASYCUDA World customs system
Master and House Airway Bill or Bill of Lading evidencing outbound movement from Samoa
Commercial invoice and detailed packing list
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) or foreign-currency credit advice from a Samoan licensed commercial bank evidencing receipt of export proceeds
Proof of non-resident status of the service recipient (e.g., foreign VAT/GST registration certificate, overseas registered address, and place-of-incorporation evidence)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Ministry for Revenue may conduct retrospective audits of export zero-rating claims for up to five years; where zero-rating is claimed fraudulently or without adequate substantiation, the taxpayer must repay the refunded VAT with interest and is liable to a civil penalty of up to 200% of the tax shortfall; criminal prosecution for tax evasion may attract a fine of up to WST$1,000,000 and imprisonment of up to seven years; directors and the registered agent who participate in false export declarations may be held jointly and severally liable; the Registrar of International and Foreign Companies may also strike off or revoke the IC's tax-exempt status for repeated serious non-compliance.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan tālā (WST) is convertible for current account transactions (trade in goods, services, and remittances of profits) under the Foreign Exchange Act 2020 and Exchange Control Regulations. Capital account transactions, including inbound share capital injections above certain thresholds and outbound investment repatriation, are subject to CBS licensing, case-by-case approval, and documentary substantiation. Profit remittances are permissible after compliance with corporate tax clearance and annual return filings; practical hurdles include the need for audited financial statements, tax compliance certificates, and foreign exchange application forms submitted through an authorised dealer. The CBS retains discretionary power to defer or reject remittances if the applicant has unresolved tax or regulatory obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Regulations, all exporters (including cross-border courier operators with invoiced export service earnings) must repatriate export proceeds to Samoa within 180 days from the date of export. There is no mandatory statutory conversion ratio into WST; however, where the exporter requires local currency to meet operational expenses, the authorised dealing bank will convert the foreign currency at the prevailing market rate. Export proceeds must be received through a CBS-licensed commercial bank and supported by a customs or service declaration form; failure to repatriate within the stipulated timeline triggers a mandatory surrender order by the CBS and may result in fines or revocation of the exporter's licence.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low - Offshore digital EMI (Electronic Money Institution) accounts are not directly viable for a Samoa International Company due to (i) Samoa's Foreign Exchange Act requiring all FX transactions to be routed through authorised CBS-licensed banks, (ii) the absence of a designated EMI licensing framework for non-resident corporate service providers, and (iii) the practical refusal of correspondent banks to clear through unregulated EMIs. An offshore EMI may be used only as a supplementary collection rail where the underlying treasury settlement and FX conversion occur through a domestic commercial bank; this structure requires a formal memorandum of understanding and approval from the CBS.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical KYC interview is mandatory. For a non-resident International Company, at least one director and the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) must appear in person before a Samoa-licensed bank officer, either at the bank's Samoa branch or through a recognized regional correspondent bank acting under a delegated KYC mandate. Remote opening is permitted only if the bank obtains prior written approval from the CBS and the applicant provides a notarised identity dossier verified by the Samoa Ministry of Foreign Affairs. A power of attorney does not satisfy this interview requirement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO appears as a politically exposed person (PEP)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed source-of-wealth statement, three years of bank statements, audited financial statements of the IC, notarised declaration of non-use for public office gains, and an independent risk assessment prepared by a CBS-licensed AML/CFT compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership structure is multi-jurisdictional with consecutive shell companies
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A full corporate ownership chart signed by a Samoa registered agent, certified copies of certificates of incorporation and good standing from each jurisdiction, a written explanation of the commercial purpose of the courier operation, and an undertaking to provide rolling 12-month beneficial ownership updates.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected FX transaction volume is disproportionate to declared courier activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan, pro forma invoices from >=2 major international logistics partners, a contract with a Samoan commercial counter-party, a projection of customs clearance volumes, and an explanation of the payment-routing rationale. The bank may additionally require an independent economic substance review under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The entity holds a letter of no objection or special licence that is not yet recognised by the bank's screening system
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised SLIPS (Samoa International Company) certificate, the Ministry of Commerce licence approval, a legal opinion from a Samoa-licensed attorney confirming the licence category, and a CBS exchange control application acknowledging the entity's licenced status.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound share capital injections must be routed through a CBS-licensed commercial bank. The remitter must use SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'Capital contributions to nonresident controlled company' (corresponding to Samoa Exchange Control Form 1) and include the company registration number. The bank will verify that the IC is maintained in good standing with the Samoa International Companies Registry, and that the funds originate from a KYC-compliant source. Aggregate inbound capital above SAT 1 million requires prior CBS approval; the authorised bank will issue a foreign exchange transaction certificate evidencing compliance with Article 17 of the Foreign Exchange Act 2020.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Disbursements for outbound trade settlements (freight forwarding, terminal handling, and international courier line-haul charges) are cleared via (i) SWIFT MT103 direct wire transfers to the beneficiary's bank, or (ii) Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) issued by the Samoan bank against the underlying courier invoices. The bank requires submission of a Samoa export entry, a courier airway bill (AWB), a commercial invoice, and a customs declaration schedule. All FX conversions for disbursements are executed at the CBS daily reference rate, and settlements to low-tax or OFAC-sanctioned counterparties trigger enhanced due diligence delays.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain vanilla forward contracts against USD with maturity up to twelve months and requiring a 20% margin deposit
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing the USD/WST rate where settlement is made in USD based on the CBS official fixing
Cross-currency swaps subject to CBS approval for tenors exceeding six months and limited to hedge of trade flows
Options embedded in forward instruments only where the underlying courier receivables are evidenced by confirmed invoices

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal Application and Annual Return filing for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour; supervised by the Samoa International Financial Authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary of incorporation; renewable certification may be submitted within a 30-day grace period following the anniversary date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal fee of US$100 per month or part of a month after the grace period; continued failure to file or pay for more than 6 months may result in administrative strike-off and dissolution of the International Company from the Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Corporate Compliance Certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent of the International Company; certificate retained at the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the company's annual general meeting of shareholders, or within 12 months of the preceding compliance review date, whichever occurs first.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Where the registered agent is unable to issue the compliance certificate due to deficient statutory records, the agent may resign; if no replacement agent is appointed within 60 days, the Registrar may initiate strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation of Beneficial Ownership Data in the Confidential UBO Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent / Designated Custodian of Statutory Registers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of incorporation, and within 30 days of any share transfer affecting substantial ownership of 10% or more.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to US$10,000 may be imposed for false, inaccurate, or stale UBO entries; sustained omission constitutes a compliance default enabling the Registrar to suspend the International Company's statutory benefits and proceed with administrative dissolution.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory independent audit is imposed on a Samoa International Company unless: (i) the company holds a regulated international financial services licence; (ii) shareholders holding at least 10% of voting rights validly require an audit; or (iii) audit is required by the reporting rules of a foreign parent undertaking.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS may be adopted voluntarily for any financial statements prepared; absent a statutory audit requirement, accounting records are normally maintained on a simplified accruals or cash basis satisfactory to the authorised bank. No public filing of financial statements is required.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Beneficial owners and significant shareholders must be identified and confirmed by the registered agent at least once every 12 months on the anniversary of incorporation. Every share transfer must be logged in the confidential UBO register; any transfer causing a change in beneficial ownership requires confirmation by the new beneficial owner and updating of the registered agent's internal records before the transfer is recognised by the registrar.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not compulsory; voluntary audit or review normally ranges from US$1,500 to US$3,500 depending on transaction volume.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for International Company; Samoa resident corporate CIT headline is 27%
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies are statutorily exempt from Samoa income tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax and stamp duty on offshore transactions; annual Government licence/annual renewal fee remains payable

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No income tax return is required for a tax-exempt International Company. Annual compliance is through the International Company Annual Return/Declaration to the Samoa Registrar of International Companies (electronic filing through the Samoa Companies Office portal; submitted by the licensed registered agent)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Before the anniversary date of incorporation or within 30 days after each anniversary date, as specified by the Registrar's annual renewal notice

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field 1 — Company name and IC number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered legal name and International Companies register number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the IC registration number exactly as shown in the certificate of incorporation; no name prefixes or suffixes beyond registered form

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the registered office in Samoa maintained by the licensed agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors may use the licensed agent's office address; a PO Box alone is not sufficient

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration whether the IC derived income from a Samoa source or carried on business in Samoa during the year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a pure offshore IC, answer 'No' to all items and confirm no domestic business, no Samoa real property, and no Samoa-source revenue

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationalities, residential addresses and dates of appointment/resignation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident natural persons are permissible; provide copies of passport and proof of address; no Samoan residency requirement for IC directors

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of participation in a relevant activity and meeting the economic substance test where applicable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For cross-border express courier income, be prepared to identify physical premises in Samoa, operational staff, and local management control; declarations are now required under Samoa's Economic Substance Regulations

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual renewal attracts an escalated Government fee, late penalty, and potential striking-off; continuing default can lead to deregistration, disqualification of the registered agent's filing status, and personal liability of each director for any ensuing unpaid fees or penalties

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for distributions paid by a tax-exempt International Company; no Samoa withholding tax applies to offshore dividends
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because IC distributions are fully exempt and not subject to Samoa WHT, a DTA relief mechanism is generally not triggered. If a treaty-resident shareholder nevertheless requires a Samoa tax residence certificate or reduced WHT, the licensed agent must file the standard Certificate of Residence application with the Samoa Ministry of Revenue (or competent authority), attach the current TRC from the treaty jurisdiction, and rely on the applicable double taxation agreement (Samoa's DTA network) for any residual rate relief
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Samoa non-resident interest/royalty withholding rate is generally 15% for taxable payers, but a tax-exempt International Company pays 0% on offshore royalties and interest; treaty rates, where a DTA applies, may further reduce or eliminate Samoan WHT, subject to TRC and beneficial ownership evidence

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Samoa does not impose local-file/master-file transfer pricing documentation on tax-exempt International Companies; for taxable resident enterprises, contemporaneous TP documentation would be required when related-party transactions exceed WST 10 million annually
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa's Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) require an International Company conducting relevant activities — which may include logistics, distribution, and service centre operations — to demonstrate substantial activities in Samoa. The company must maintain premises in Samoa, an adequate number of full-time employees, and local management; file annual economic substance declarations; and ensure the courier revenue is commensurate with physical substance. Pure letterbox structures without local substance are liable to penalties and recharacterization

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and False Declaration of Tax-Exempt Status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing a false annual declaration that no Samoa-source income was derived while the IC actually operated a local Samoa courier or delivery network, or knowingly understating revenue from cross-border express courier services
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imposition of the full CIT at 27% on undeclared Samoa-source income, unpaid withholding taxes, interest at statutory rate, and penalty surcharges up to 200% of the tax deficiency; deregistration of the International Company
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for the company's unpaid taxes where the false declaration was made knowingly; the court may impose imprisonment of up to 7 years, monetary restitution, and asset freezing orders

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Failure of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a letterbox entity with no physical office in Samoa, no staff, no board minutes in Samoa, and no economic substance declaration, while booking cross-border courier profit through Samoa
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties under Samoa's Economic Substance Regulations for each relevant activity, possible default deemed taxable profit assessment, loss of IC tax-exempt status, and strike-off by the Registrar
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally liable for ESR penalties and default assessments if they knowingly certified false substance information; management interference or personal benefit may lead to piercing the corporate veil and disqualification orders

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Relying on the tax-exempt IC as an unregulated payment corridor for express courier collections, failing to register as a reporting entity, or handling cash/payment instruments without customer due diligence and AML controls
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Regulatory fines, confiscation of funds, suspension or revocation of the courier business licence, and referral to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit for criminal prosecution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Senior officers face severe criminal penalties including imprisonment up to 15 years, personal fines, travel bans, and freezing of personal and corporate assets; the corporate veil is pierced for breaches committed with the directors' knowledge or reckless indifference

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Conducting cross-border express courier and time-definite parcel services in Samoa without the requisite postal/courier licence and without satisfying the ISIC 5320 operational licensing requirements
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Cease-and-desist orders, deregistration of the IC, forfeiture of equipment and revenue, and civil penalties per shipment found to be in violation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorized the unlicensed operations are personally liable for restitution to customers and for regulatory fines; egregious conduct may result in imprisonment, director disqualification, and travel bans pending investigation
